_readme: VERIFIED RATES ONLY. The website assistant may quote a fare only if it is listed here AND the customer's pickup/drop are the two ends of that route (Katra, Jammu, Udhampur, Chenani or Kudh <-> Patnitop). Every other trip is left for you to quote manually. This file ships EMPTY on purpose: no price has been entered. To add a rate, copy the example into the 'rates' list, fill in the real fare you have confirmed yourself, then run: python3 build.py. A fare is not quoted 90 days after verified_on, so re-verify and update the date regularly.

_example_not_active.includes: Describe what the fare covers, e.g. tolls/parking/waiting/night charges included or not
